app.port_busy:
Port {port} is in use by another program, so the bridge can't start.

Start the bridge on another port, for example: MKSBridge.exe --port 5001,
and set that port in the printer settings in Orca (http://127.0.0.1:5001).

ref.g1: Move: G1 X50 Y50 F3000. X, Y, Z — target, mm; F — speed in mm/min (3000 = 50 mm/s)
ref.g28xy: Home X and Y only (Z untouched)
ref.g90: Absolute coordinates: G1 X50 means “go to X = 50” (the normal mode)
ref.g91: Relative coordinates: G1 X10 means “10 mm to the right”. Switch back to G90 after moving!
ref.g92: Tell the printer “I am here now” without moving: G92 E0 resets the filament counter. X, Y, Z, E — new values
ref.hint: Clicking inserts the command into the input line below: add parameters and press Enter. Red ones ask for confirmation when sent.
ref.m104: Nozzle: set temperature and don't wait. M104 S200; S — degrees, S0 — off
ref.m105: Nozzle and bed temperatures: current / target
ref.m106: Part cooling fan: M106 S128. S — power from 0 to 255: S128 ≈ 50 %, S255 — full
ref.m107: Turn the part cooling fan off
ref.m109: Nozzle: set temperature and wait until reached. M109 S235
ref.m112: EMERGENCY stop. The printer needs a restart
ref.m114: Current X Y Z E position
ref.m117: Show text on the printer screen: M117 Hello
ref.m140: Bed: set temperature and don't wait. M140 S60; S — degrees, S0 — off
ref.m190: Bed: set temperature and wait until reached. M190 S80
ref.m20: List of files on the SD card
ref.m201: Acceleration limit: M201 X3000 Y3000, mm/s². The printer won't accelerate faster even if the slicer asks
ref.m203: Speed limit: M203 X200 Y200. Note: mm/s here, not mm/min as in G1
ref.m204: Working accelerations: M204 P1500 T3000. P — printing, T — travel moves, mm/s²; not above M201
ref.m205: Jerk: M205 X10 Y10 — the speed, mm/s, at which the head takes a corner without a full stop
ref.m220: Print speed: M220 S120 — 20 % faster. S — percent, 100 — as in the G-code
ref.m221: Flow: M221 S95 — extrude 5 % less. S — percent, 100 — as in the G-code
ref.m23: Select a file on the card: M23 name.gcode
ref.m24: Start the selected file / resume after a pause
ref.m26: Stop the print (on MKS, as in the Cura plugin; in stock Marlin M26 sets the file position)
ref.m290: Babystep Z on the fly: M290 Z-0.05. Z — by how many mm, minus — closer to the bed. Not saved
ref.m300: Beep: M300 S440 P200. S — pitch, Hz; P — duration, ms
ref.m301: Nozzle PID by hand: M301 P9.66 I0.88 D26.67 — the three numbers from M303 or M503
ref.m302: Allow cold extrusion: M302 P1 (P0 — forbid again). Only for checking the mechanics
ref.m303: PID autotune: M303 E0 S235 C8 U1. E0 — nozzle (E-1 — bed); S — temperature; C — number of cycles; U1 — apply at once. It heats — stay nearby
ref.m304: Bed PID by hand: M304 P54.5 I10.6 D186
ref.m400: Wait for all moves to finish
ref.m410: Quick stop: the move queue is flushed. Heaters stay on
ref.m413: Power-loss recovery: M413 S1 — on, S0 — off
ref.m500: Save current settings to the board's memory (EEPROM)
ref.m501: Load settings from the board's memory
ref.m502: Reset settings to factory defaults (without saving)
ref.m503: All board settings: steps, accelerations, PID, input shaper, offsets
ref.m593: Input Shaping (cancels ringing after corners): M593 X F75 D0.15. X or Y — axis (none — both); F — frequency, Hz (F0 — off); D — damping
ref.m82: Absolute extrusion: E in G1 is the filament position, not “how much to push”
ref.m83: Relative extrusion: G1 E5 F100 pushes 5 mm. Handy for manual feeding
ref.m84: Disable motors: the axes can be moved by hand
ref.m900: Linear Advance: M900 K0.04. K — nozzle pressure compensation; K0 — off
ref.m92: Steps per millimetre: M92 E720. Used to calibrate extruder feed (e-steps); X, Y, Z are usually left alone
ref.m994: MKS: name of the file being printed
